semanticChecks: Two-pass nodes/ports before edges/labels; root geometry has no parent adjustment
Original JSON edge owner differs from current semantic containment
Only nonempty sections/bends/relations/junctions overwrite corresponding original keys
Old sections require IDs; one simple section auto-binds only if both shape links absent
Relations have inverse semantic links; original JSON identity and business fields retained
Primitive source/target edges import separately from modern sources/targets
GWT identity hashes are process runtime side effects, never generated per graph
nativeBoundary: Use accepted typed Python str/int identity and finite geometry validation; numeric GWT casts not adopted
Duplicate IDs and invalid containers retain strict native errors
Owned input copy is a native API policy; official worker may mutate its input
Central typed option parsing and recursive scheduling are separate unapproved implementation work
